Select drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID as indication_curie, EFO term as indication_label, and max phase for indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter for max_phase_for_ind equal to 4. Sort by drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max phase for indication.
